images.title: Shock
images.alt: Red octopus character with huge eyes glancing upward, motion lines above its head
images.description: Eyes wide and darting upward with shock lines overhead, like a deploy that failed on the first push.

images.title: Confusion
images.alt: Red octopus character with mismatched eyes looking up and a small puzzled mouth
images.description: Mismatched eyes and a crooked little mouth: the universal face of reading an error message twice.

images.title: Regret
images.alt: Red octopus character covering its mouth with both tentacles, eyes squeezed shut
images.description: Both tentacles clapped over its mouth with eyes shut tight, hiding from a commit it should not have made.

images.title: Coffee Break
images.alt: Red octopus character sipping from a cream colored mug with eyes closed contentedly
images.description: Eyes closed around a warm mug. The calmest moment of the build, right before the logs scroll.

images.title: Frustration
images.alt: Red octopus character with furrowed brow and a sharp downturned frown
images.description: Furrowed brow and a hard frown, aimed squarely at a port that is already in use.

images.title: Delight
images.alt: Red octopus character laughing with wide open eyes and a big open mouth
images.description: Wide eyes and an open laugh, caught the instant the container finally reports healthy.

images.title: Smug
images.alt: Red octopus character with a sly sideways glance and a lopsided grin
images.description: A sideways glance and a lopsided grin, worn by anyone who fixed it by deleting four lines.

images.title: Queasy
images.alt: Red octopus character trembling with a wobbly tongue out and shake lines around it
images.description: Trembling with shake lines and a wobbly tongue out, the look of a live demo with no backup plan.

images.title: Unimpressed
images.alt: Red octopus character with one eye half closed in a flat deadpan stare
images.description: One eye half closed in a flat deadpan stare, reserved for advice that begins with have you tried.

images.title: Despair
images.alt: Red octopus character bawling with blue tears streaming down and mouth wide open
images.description: Blue tears streaming and mouth wide open, the full collapse of losing unsaved work.

images.title: Nervous
images.alt: Red octopus character with large eyes glancing to the side and a tiny dot of a mouth
images.description: Large eyes cutting to the side above a tiny dot of a mouth, hoping nobody asks a follow up question.

images.title: Surprise
images.alt: Red octopus character with round startled eyes and a small open mouth
images.description: Round startled eyes and a small open mouth, the face of a notification arriving at 2 a.m.
